## Bio

I am a senior research fellow at the UCL Institute of Neurology, where I work as an AI/ML researcher and computational scientist investigating the applications of high-performance computing and deep learning to address complex challenges in neuroscience and clinical practice. I studied Theoretical Physics at UCL before I completed my PhD in Computational Plasma Physics at Imperial College London. I have been a reviewer for a range journals, such as [Imaging Neuroscience](https://direct.mit.edu/imag) and [Physics of Plasmas](https://pubs.aip.org/aip/pop). I am a member of the [Institute of Physics](https://www.iop.org) and several other learned societies. And I have presented my work across both physics and neuroscience at conferences such as EPS Plasma Physics the Brain conference.
